excluded_detectors.reason: Not run: its regex nests unbounded repetitions ((...\n)*)* and backtracks exponentially on files with loops and no delegatecall (more than ten minutes on CollateralizationLedger.sol alone). Slither's delegatecall-loop and msg-value-loop detectors, which run in the same fast tier with no exclusion, check the same pattern on the compiled code.
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector (performance). Checked 2026-11-11 repo-wide: the five delegatecall sites (ParameterStoreRouter, MarketRegistryRouter, LPOracle x3) are single calls, none in a loop, and src/ has no msg.value; Slither delegatecall-loop and msg-value-loop run unexcluded.

excluded_detectors.check: Solidity version 0.8.20+ may not work on other chains due to `PUSH0`
excluded_detectors.reason: Avana compiles for EVM cancun (REQ-ARCH-053); PUSH0 exists on every chain Avana deploys to. Aderyn's push-zero-opcode is excluded for the same reason.
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector. Checked 2026-11-11: foundry.toml evm_version = cancun and solc 0.8.28 for all of src/; not one of the eight approved patterns (was marked approved-pattern by mistake).

excluded_detectors.reason: Every privileged function is held by the AvanaTimelock by design (2.15 role table); the role checks are reviewed through the spec's permission tables and the hostile-component tests, not one finding per function. Aderyn's centralization-risk is excluded for the same reason.
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector. Checked 2026-11-11: every admin role is TIMELOCK-only by _grantRole override; not one of the eight approved patterns.

excluded_detectors.check: Upgradeable contract is missing a `__gap[50]` storage variable to allow for new storage variables in later versions
excluded_detectors.reason: Avana's upgradeable contracts keep all state in ERC-7201 namespaces (OpenZeppelin 5 pattern, REQ-ARCH-050), where a storage gap has no role; the layout step snapshots every namespace and fails on any change to an existing slot.
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector. Checked 2026-11-11 repo-wide: the three UUPS contracts (DebtOracle, MarketRegistry, ParameterStore) and the LPOracle keep state only in ERC-7201 namespaces; every layout snapshot has zero plain storage slots. Not one of the eight approved patterns.

excluded_detectors.reason: Regex on any line that names an upgradeable base or an initializer (it matches interfaces, the timelock's selector list and the initializer bodies themselves). The property it approximates, that every upgradeable base is initialized and the implementation's initializers are disabled, is checked on compiled code by slither-check-upgradeability and by OpenZeppelin upgrades-core validate (missing-initializer, missing-initializer-call) in the same tier.
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector. Checked 2026-11-11: each UUPS constructor calls _disableInitializers and slither-check-upgradeability plus upgrades-core validate run in the same tier.

excluded_detectors.reason: Every Avana proxy runs initialize in the ERC1967Proxy constructor, in the deploying transaction (REQ-ACCESS-150, script/README.md step 3), so no transaction can come between deployment and initialization; the regex matches every initialize declaration, interfaces included. slither-check-upgradeability's initialize checks run in the same tier.
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector. Checked 2026-11-11: initialize runs in the ERC1967Proxy constructor (REQ-ACCESS-150, script/README.md step 3), and each initialize also rejects any timelock other than the implementation's immutable TIMELOCK, so a front-run could not take the admin role.

excluded_detectors.check: Fees can be set to be greater than 100%.
excluded_detectors.reason: Regex on any setter whose name contains `fee` (it also matches setFeed*, setFeeRecipient and _feedChanged) without a literal bound in the same function. Every ParameterStore setter checks the hard bounds of 1.5 (OutOfBounds; maxFlashFeeBps <= FLASH_FEE_MAX_BPS, avanaFeeShareBps <= FEE_SHARE_MAX_BPS), covered by the ParameterStore unit tests; collectFees transfers accrued fees and sets none.
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector. Checked 2026-11-11 repo-wide: the only fee setters are ParameterStore's (setMaxFlashFeeBps <= FLASH_FEE_MAX_BPS = 100, setAvanaFeeShareBps <= FEE_SHARE_MAX_BPS = 5,000, and the same bounds in initialize). A fee setter added elsewhere would not be flagged by this detector.

excluded_detectors.reason: Flags every division. Avana's rounding direction is part of each formula's specification (floor or ceil against the user or protocol), checked by the Z3 and SymPy models and the differential suites; Slither's divide-before-multiply runs in the same tier.
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector. Checked 2026-11-11: rounding direction is specified per formula and checked by Z3/SymPy and the differential suites; Slither divide-before-multiply runs.

excluded_detectors.check: `decimals()` is not a part of the ERC-20 standard
excluded_detectors.reason: Avana reads decimals() only from tokens it configures through a timelock operation or a deployment: listed tokens (the listing reverts if the call fails, REQ-CONFIG-050; MarketRegistry's credit-line coverage check reads a listed debt asset), the constructor checks of PegModuleRoute (its tokenOut) and AvanaFirstLossReserve (its Hub asset), the LPOracle's guarded static read, and oracle interfaces (Chainlink AggregatorV3, Aave V4 oracle and price feeds, Avana's LPOracle) where decimals() is part of the interface. A token without decimals() makes the configuring call revert (fail closed).
excluded_detectors.review: Excluded detector. Checked 2026-11-11 repo-wide; the reason was incomplete and is corrected: besides listed tokens and oracle interfaces, decimals() is read in constructors of PegModuleRoute (tokenOut) and AvanaFirstLossReserve (Hub asset) and by MarketRegistry's credit-line coverage check, each of which reverts for a token without decimals() (fail closed).

accepted.check: `abi.encodePacked()` should not be used with dynamic types when passing the result to a hash function such as `keccak256()`
accepted.reason: The only abi.encodePacked in this file is _push's abi.encodePacked(b.actions, action), which appends one action byte to the PositionManager's packed action string as v4-periphery expects; the result goes to modifyLiquidities and is never hashed. 4naly3er reports the instance on a blank line (537, three lines below _push), so the fingerprint is a blank line's; reviewedFiles pins the review to the file as read.
